content.text: In Bangladesh, digital creators face a stark reality: Stripe and PayPal are not options. Your ability to sell [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-sell-ebooks-kenya-everything-you-need-get-5|COREMERCH guide to ebooks]], courses, or templates hinges on infrastructure you control. This is not about workarounds. It’s about building a commerce stack where payment processing, file delivery, and customer data are yours—not rented from a platform that can suspend you without warning. Crypto solves the payment problem, but only if integrated into a system you own. This post compares architectures that deliver [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/financial-sovereignty-digital-creators-crypto-honest-side-side-3|Financial Sovereignty]] sovereignty, focusing on ownership, cost, and resilience. We’ll analyze GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-supabase-order-database-digital-stores-works-how-4|supabase]], and NOWPayments as base-layer tools. The goal: to show you how to deploy a stack where no single entity can shut you down.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/coremerch-sovereign-stack-deployment-guide-which-architecture-actually-4. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.
content.title: Sovereign Commerce Infrastructure for Digital Creators

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers

Conventional platforms like Gumroad or Lemon Squeezy offer convenience but retain control over your storefront, customer list, and payment flow. They fail in restricted regions like Bangladesh. Sovereign architectures flip this model. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages host your storefront for free, while Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic without subscriptions. Supabase or Google Sheets store orders, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 deliver files. NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides blueprints for all five stacks, ensuring you own the code, data, and wallet addresses. This is not SaaS—it’s infrastructure you deploy and control. The tradeoff: you manage deployment, but gain immunity to platform suspension or geographic gatekeeping.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

Platforms like Stripe and PayPal block Bangladesh due to regulatory or risk concerns. Sovereign stacks bypass this by using decentralized payment networks (BSC, Solana, TRON) with fees under $0.10 per transaction. NOWPayments verifies payments on-chain, triggering file delivery or email confirmations via Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script. Your storefront runs on globally distributed networks (GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Pages), ensuring uptime regardless of local restrictions. Customer data resides in Supabase or Google Sheets, accessible only by you. This architecture is pressure-tested in Zimbabwe, where currency collapse and financial isolation are the norm. It’s built for creators who need commerce systems that function when traditional finance fails.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

Crypto payments confirm in minutes, not days. NOWPayments’ 0.5% fee is lower than PayPal’s 2.9% + $0.30. Transaction costs on BSC, Solana, or TRON are negligible—under $0.10 per sale. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) is a one-time purchase, not a subscription. Compare this to Shopify’s $29/month + 2% fee or Gumroad’s 10% cut. Sovereign stacks have no recurring costs after deployment. The only expense is the NOWPayments fee and minimal cloud storage fees (if using Supabase or Cloudflare R2). This model is cheaper for creators selling high-margin digital products. It’s not free, but it’s owned—and ownership eliminates platform taxes forever.
Sovereign stacks give you full ownership of your commerce infrastructure—no platform can suspend you.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

With sovereign stacks, you own the storefront code, customer database, order history, and product files. Payments go directly to your wallet—no intermediary holds your funds. Automation is handled via Cloudflare Workers or Apps Script, ensuring instant file delivery or email notifications post-payment. COREMERCH deploys the stack but has no access afterward. This is critical: no entity can suspend your store or withhold your revenue. The Complete Builder Kit includes templates for email sequences, refund handling, and product updates—all automated via tools you control. This level of ownership is impossible on rented platforms. It’s the difference between leasing a storefront and building your headquarters.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

If you’re selling 1-3 products and need speed, the Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) deploys GitHub Pages + Apps Script + NOWPayments in 48 hours. For 5+ products with advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC email config, the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) uses Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase. If you want full control, the Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for self-deployment. Choose based on product volume, technical comfort, and need for email deliverability. All options ensure financial sovereignty—no platform dependency, no geographic restrictions. This is commerce infrastructure built for creators who refuse to be locked out.
What does sovereign commerce infrastructure mean for digital creators?

Sovereign commerce stacks using GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments offer digital creators in Bangladesh full ownership of their storefront, customer data, and payment flow. These tools bypass geographic restrictions, eliminate platform fees, and ensure payments go directly to your wallet. The Complete Builder Kit ($197) provides all blueprints and templates for deployment, ensuring you control every layer of your commerce infrastructure.
NOWPayments processes crypto payments with a 0.5% fee, no KYC, and no buyer accounts required.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Creators researching infrastructure ownership and no-KYC payment options are typically at a turning point — ready to build on infrastructure they control after experiencing or observing the asymmetric risk of platform dependency. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete sovereign deployment: Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, all under your accounts, end-to-end tested before handoff. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the complete build process for both Stack 01 and Stack 02 for creators who want to self-deploy. COREMERCH has no access after delivery. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack ($97) for 1-3 products or Edge Commerce Stack ($197) for 5+ products. 2. Purchase the Complete Builder Kit ($197) for full blueprints and templates. 3. Deploy your storefront on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 4. Set up backend logic with Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script. 5. Configure Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage. 6. Integrate NOWPayments for crypto payment processing. 7. Test end-to-end: payment verification, file delivery, email notifications. 8. Load your products and launch.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?

Yes. The Complete Builder Kit includes step-by-step guides and templates. Basic technical skills are required, but no coding expertise is needed. COREMERCH also offers deployment services for those who prefer a hands-off approach.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees are BSC, Solana, and TRON. You can select which coins to accept via the NOWPayments dashboard.
How do I handle refunds?
Refunds are processed manually via your wallet. The Complete Builder Kit includes a refund template and automation script to notify customers post-refund.
Can platforms like GitHub or Cloudflare suspend my store?

Suspension is possible if you violate their terms (e.g., selling illegal content). However, since you own the code and data, you can redeploy on another provider without losing customer information or sales history.
What happens if NOWPayments goes down?
NOWPayments has 99.9% uptime. If an outage occurs, payments will queue and process once service is restored. Your stack remains operational, and customer data is secure.
